Three.js r180: MIT License, see LICENSE-three.txt.
Human rig base: Xbot sample distributed in the Three.js examples, sourced from Mixamo.
Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r180/examples/models/gltf/Xbot.glb
Character clothing shells, LED layout, cap, visor, instruments, screens, capes and poses are custom LIGHTMAN scene geometry.
Visual reference: https://www.tiktok.com/@lightman.pe/video/7672570775979085076
This is an approximate recreation, not a scan of the performers.

Urban and Tron head: Infinite, 3D Head Scan by Lee Perry-Smith / Infinite-Realities. Converted by Morgan McGuire and Guedis Cardenas. Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/.
Source: Three.js r180 examples/models/gltf/LeePerrySmith and https://casual-effects.com/data/.
Changes: bust cropped, resized and fitted to articulated body, with custom Urban hat/glasses or a frontal Tron mask; ears and neck remain exposed. Generic face, not an event performer likeness.
Licence reference: https://github.com/keijiro/InfiniteScan

Audio: Batucada | Festival Internacional de Artes Vivas 2018 - Viko. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ao6GSvsmZjs . Creative Commons Attribution (reuse allowed), according to YouTube metadata. MP3 conversion, loudness normalization and fades. Full attribution in credits.html.
